title: SF 2040
tagline: Forty-one days after Erebus. One rider, one horse, a city gone wild. Find them.

Cal.role: Cal Mercer, an ex-park ranger looking for his family

Nina.role: Dr. Nina Mercer, his wife, an ER doctor

Hollis.role: runs the camp's radio at the Ferry Building

Radio.role: a voice on the emergency band

Vale.role: Deacon Vale, who leads the Iron Saints

shots.text: Erebus broke up over the Pacific. One piece came down on the Presidio, and the Bio-Preserve's walls came down with it.

sub: ...this is Nina Mercer... June and I are... Market and Church... medicine... anyone...
Message is three days old, Cal. And forty families here haven't eaten since Tuesday.
Then I ride Market for food, and I keep riding.

quote.text: Ranger knew the way home before I did.

missions.title: Market Street
missions.stakes: Forty families. Two days of food left on Market St, if the Iron Saints haven't found it.
nudge: Cal, you there? The yellow line on your map. Follow it.

steps.text: Crates fell off the relief trucks all down Market. Bring back five.
And take the bat. The Saints don't ask twice.

steps.objective: Mount **Ranger**.

steps.text: Come on, Ranger.

steps.objective: Ride up **Market St**.
help: [W] trots. Hold [Shift] to gallop, and [Q] slows him to a walk.
[Space] jumps Ranger over what's in the way. The yellow line is the way.

steps.label: Food
steps.objective: Scavenge **food** along Market St.
help: Ride over a crate to take it. You don't need to get down.

lines: Cal, you hear me? Keep off the side streets. Hybrids nest in the old garages.
And Cal. If Nina's out there, she's smart. She'll leave word.

steps.text: Armour on the corner. Iron Saints. They want the crates.

steps.objective: Fight off the **Iron Saints**.
help: In the saddle, [J] swings the bat at whoever is beside you. [K] and Ranger kicks out behind.
Or get down with [F] and fight on foot: [J] hits, [Q] counters.

steps.text: Don't! Please. They make us wear it.
Then take it off and go home, kid.
It's Pike. My name's Pike. I won't forget this.

lines: Rider on Market. That's Saint property on your saddle.
Everything in this city belongs to someone now. Tithe night is Sunday. Tell your camp.

steps.objective: Ride the food back to **the Embarcadero camp**.

lines: That was Deacon Vale. He runs the Saints out of the old Preserve trucks.
The night they come for what you owe. Camps that don't pay get visitors. The big kind.

sub: Five crates. The kids are already fighting over the peaches.
Market and Church. That's where she called from.
Then bring her medicine too. And watch Octavia. Something big nests under the ramps.
Water first. Then we ride. Right, Ranger?

missions.title: Quiet Hooves
missions.stakes: Nina's last call came from the pharmacy at Market & Church. Something sleeps on the street in front of it.
missions.passLine: Medicine for the camp. And Nina's handwriting.
nudge: Cal? Talk to me. Slow and quiet, and keep going.

radio: Octavia's west, up Market. Slow out there, Cal. Slow is alive.

steps.objective: Ride up Market toward **Octavia**.

say: Wild ones. Easy, Ranger. They're not ours.

lines: Cal. The pharmacy's a block past the Octavia ramps. Something's been nesting there since the impact.
Scorpions, big as dogs. And their mother. Bigger.
At dusk, like the dead. But don't run him in there. A trot sounds like a drum to them.

steps.text: Egg sacs on the ramp. Easy, Ranger. Easy.

steps.objective: Walk **Ranger** past the nest to **the pharmacy**.
steps.why: The brood woke. They heard Ranger coming.

steps.objective: Get down. **Quietly**.

steps.label: Medicine
steps.objective: Search the pharmacy for **medicine**.

sub: A note, taped to the register. Her writing.

shots.caption: Nina's note
shots.text: "Moving the patients to the hospital on Hyde St, the Civic Center way. June is with me. The animals' collars are still transmitting, Cal. Something is calling them. If you find this: we're alive. N."

sub: And that's the shop bell. Oh, no.

steps.objective: Kill **The Brood Mother** and her brood.
Back on **Ranger**.

steps.text: Hyde St, the Civic Center way. Hang on, Nina.

missions.title: Wild Horses
missions.stakes: Tithe night is Sunday. The camp needs horses to move, and a wild herd grazes on Civic Center Plaza under a silverback's eye.
missions.passLine: Horses for the camp. And a name: WARDEN-7.
nudge: Cal? Everything all right out there? The route's on your map.

radio: Medicine's in the clinic tent. Cal, if we're moving people before Sunday, we need horses.

steps.objective: Ride to **Civic Center Plaza**.

lines: Rider. You took my crates and you woke my Brood Mother. That's a debt.
Everything with a collar on it answers to someone. Sunday, rider.
Cal, don't answer him. Just don't.
What did he mean, answers to someone?
Civic Center's coming up on your right.

steps.text: Wild horses on the plaza. And something sitting on the steps, watching them.

steps.objective: Bring down **Old Silver**.

steps.text: A collar on him. Preserve tags. Still blinking.

steps.label: Backpack
steps.objective: Check **the backpack** on City Hall's steps.

sub: June's backpack. The patch her grandma sewed on.
Her inhaler's still in it. She's got the spare. Hyde St, then.

shots.caption: A page of Nina's notebook
shots.text: "Every collar answers one tone. WARDEN-7, the Preserve's security unit, sends it. Somebody turned it back on. The signal comes from Hyde St."

steps.objective: Mount **Ranger**: the camp needs those horses.

steps.label: Horses
steps.objective: Drive the **wild horses** into **the corral on Fulton St**
nudge: Ride round behind them, Cal. They run away from Ranger, so push them toward the rope.

lines: I see them on the rope line! Three horses, Cal. You beautiful man.
Where did you hear that name?
Go to Hyde St. I'll tell you when you're back. I promise.

missions.title: The Shepherd
missions.stakes: The hospital on Hyde St. The Preserve's security mech walks its forecourt, and every collar in the city answers its call.
missions.passLine: The shepherd is silent. Hollis's secret isn't.
nudge: Rider, you still there? Hyde St. Everything you need is on your radar.

radio: Rider? It's Pike. From Market. Vale parked the big machine at the hospital. It calls the animals.
Three relay boxes on the street keep it loud. Break those and it goes quiet.

steps.objective: Ride up **Hyde St** to the hospital.

say: CONTAINMENT BREACH. ALL SPECIMENS RETURN TO ENCLOSURE.

steps.text: Hybrids. Preserve tags still on them.

steps.objective: Get past the **hybrids** and **WARDEN-7**.

steps.text: BROADCAST CONTINUING. ALL SPECIMENS: COME HOME.
It's still calling them. Pike said three relays.

steps.name: call
steps.label: THE CALL
steps.why: The tone drew every creature for a mile onto the block.

steps.label: Relays
steps.objective: Smash the **relays** before the herds arrive.
help: Ride over each relay box to smash it. They're on the radar.

2: That's two! The last one's on Bush St!

steps.objective: Go to **WARDEN-7's core**, in its wreck on the forecourt.

sub: BROADCAST INTERRUPTED. OPERATOR DETECTED. AWAITING COMMAND.
It's asking me. It's asking me what to do with them.

shots.caption: Pike, on the radio
sub: Smash the core and nobody calls them ever again. Not Vale. Not anybody. They just run wild.

shots.caption: Pike, on the radio
sub: Or send one last tone. Home. Every collar in the city walks back to the Preserve. Even the big ones.
Back to the crater. Or loose for good.

steps.prompt: WARDEN-7's core. One command left. What does Cal send?

options.text: SMASH THE CORE: no one can ever call them again. They run wild, and free.
SEND THEM HOME: one last tone, and every collar walks back to the Preserve.

shots.text: Every collar goes dark at once. The horses on Bush St shake their heads, and scatter.
Nothing calls them now. Not Vale. Not anyone.
The horses on Bush St lift their heads, turn as one, and start walking west.
All over the city, the herds turn toward the red glow over the Presidio. Even the big ones.

steps.text: CORE OFFLINE.
RECALL TONE SENT. ALL SPECIMENS: RETURN HOME.

steps.label: Search the doors
steps.objective: Search **the hospital doors**.

shots.caption: Chalk on the doors
shots.text: "Generator died. Took everyone up to the big grey house on Washington St, by Lafayette Park. High ground. Hurry. N."

sub: You were using it on people.
I was keeping order. Ask your radio man who let them out.
Ask Hollis who opened the Preserve gates the night Erebus fell.
I was the night keeper. The fires were coming over the wall, Cal. They'd have burned in their pens.
So I opened every gate. I thought they'd run for the hills.
I know. I've sat at this radio forty-one days trying to make it right.
We'll talk when I've got my family.

missions.title: Lafayette Park
missions.stakes: The grey house on Washington St. Between it and Cal: the top of Lafayette Park, and something that nests there.
missions.passLine: Home is three people and a horse.
nudge: Cal? Listen for her. She's close.

radio: Cal. Does June still have her whistle? The ranger one?
Three short. I'm here. I taught her when she was six.
Then use yours. Sound carries up there.

steps.objective: Ride to the foot of **Lafayette Park**.

lines: Hollis. Why didn't you tell me?
Because you'd have stopped listening to the radio. And then you'd never have heard her.

steps.text: She's up there somewhere. Come on, Junebug. Answer me.

steps.label: Whistle
steps.objective: Follow **June's whistle** up the hill.
steps.help: Three short blasts, and an answer. No route for this one: listen, and watch the WHISTLE bar fill as you get closer.

steps.text: Dad? Dad, is that you?
June! Stay inside! Stay in the house!
That's no hill. Ranger. GO!

steps.objective: Lead **The Matriarch** away from the house. Ride east for **Franklin St**!

5: Away from the house. Away from the house!
14: Come on, you big lizard. This way!

steps.objective: Bring down **The Matriarch**.
help: Keep moving. Strike when she's done snapping, then get clear.

steps.text: Stay down. Please. Just stay down.

steps.objective: Ride back up to **the house on Washington St**.
Go to **the house on Washington St**.

sub: Junebug. I've got you. I've got you.
Three notes. A backpack. And one very angry lizard.
Is that Ranger? You kept Ranger?
He kept me. Come on. The camp needs a doctor.

shots.text: West, over the Presidio, the crater still glows. But tonight the Mercers are together.

missions.title: Homecoming
missions.stakes: Dawn. The Mercers ride into the Embarcadero camp, and Deacon Vale comes to collect.
nudge: Cal, the camp needs you on that horse.

radio: Camp's awake, Cal. Everybody wants to see the doctor.

steps.text: Dawn

sub: Doctor Mercer. June. I'm glad. I'm so glad.
You're the radio man. You said Dad's name every night.
Somebody had to keep saying it.
Rider! Vale's coming down the Embarcadero. All of them. He's got brutes on chains.
Nina, get the kids behind the trucks. June...
I know. The radio tower. I'll call them out.

steps.objective: Mount **Ranger**: you hold this camp from the saddle.

guard.label: CAMP
guard.why: They reached the tents. The camp is lost.

steps.objective: Ride out and stop each wave before it reaches **the tents**.
help: Each wave marches on the tents from the red marker. Meet them on the way and they turn on you instead. [J] swings the bat from the saddle.

say: Dad! Three Saints, coming down Clay St!
Two hybrids from Steuart St! By the piers!
It's him! Big armour, by the Ferry Building!
wake: Rider. You owe me a city.

steps.text: Enough. Enough.
Stay down, Vale. Nobody here owes you anything.

sub: You opened them so they wouldn't burn.
That's what a keeper does. So keep something. You're on Ranger duty.
He kept me alive forty-one days. You'll have to ask him.
Cal. Look. They're coming out of the tents.

shots.text: No more shepherds. What came out of the Bio-Preserve runs wild in the city now, and it runs from people.
One last tone went out from Hyde St. By morning the herds were walking west, home to the Presidio.

sub: Enclosure B. Seal failure. Enclosure B. Seal failure.

shots.text: Something in the crater is waking up.

nudge: Cal? You still with me? The route's on your map.
